model_gaps: No act type for consent (Zustimmung): the consent of Friedrich and his father is typed rv:Confirmation with rf:qualifier "Zustimmung" as nearest fit; a dedicated consent type is needed.

No act type for the foundation of a religious house (Errichtung des Frauenstiftes Lochgarten): the foundation by Konstantin and Giselbert is not recorded as an act of its own, only as the object of the consent, with both as rv:Beneficiary references; a founder role is missing.
No state type for personal dependency or subjection (Untertanen von Lorch): the status of Konstantin and Giselbert as subjects of Lorch is not recorded.
The capacity in which the consent is given (als Inhaber der Vogtei) is recorded as a separate RightHolding factoid; the contract has no property linking an act to the capacity that grounds it.
The witness mention in DK. III. 128 was treated as a formulaic witness list and left out; whether a regest that consists of a witness attestation should yield a factoid is an open expert question.

Declaration of feud (sagt ... Fehde an), capture and release without ransom (entgegen dem Rat, Lösegeld von ihm zu fordern) have no act type; rv:Dispute is defined as a dispute before a court or ruler and does not fit a feud. Treated as military and captivity matter out of scope; the declined ransom is not a payment or debt release. Expert review should decide whether feud declaration is a legal act in scope.
